name: marketplace
description: Location-based multi-vendor marketplace (Team 30, Cursor Hackathon Jimma)

scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @marketplace/contracts" "npm run dev -w @marketplace/backend" "npm run dev -w @marketplace/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @marketplace/backend && npm run build -w @marketplace/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test -w @marketplace/backend && npm run test -w @marketplace/frontend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:contracts && npm run test:e2e -w @marketplace/frontend
